acceptance: Evidence-tool session and trace results omit direct and indirect filesystem paths while preserving bounded read-only evidence behavior.

Provider-free fixtures cover direct, nested, absolute, repository-relative, component-derived, configured-directory, worktree, session, task-record, log, and malformed path-bearing values across summaries, entries, messages, full results, and trace queries.
Private filesystem operands remain usable internally; unavailable, malformed, out-of-scope, and unsafe observations remain explicit and fail closed.
Tracer, launcher/recovery, process-adapter, task, validation, and completion authority remain outside this task.
Focused validation, durable changelog evidence, exact backlog cleanup, and transient task cleanup are completed in one scoped completion commit.
